content:
Apple yesterday released the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, and is now also rolling out the public beta version. Details are as follows.

macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 is now available

Apple announced last week that it would skip the macOS 27.1 beta cycle and go straight to releasing the first developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate. Yesterday, the company released the second developer beta.

This move appears to be related to the iPhone Duo, which will come pre-installed with iOS 27.1 when it launches on October 23. iOS 27.1 will likely focus primarily on features and changes specific to this new foldable device, so Apple is pushing the other operating systems directly to 27.2 for beta testing.

As for the contents of the macOS 27.2 beta so far, the most notable is the expansion of languages supported by Siri AI, as Apple promised to achieve in October. As of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 2, Siri AI has added support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish in addition to English.

The build number for the macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 release is 26B5091g, the same as the second developer beta.

If you would like to participate in Apple's free public beta program, please visit beta.apple.com.
